additional_info.subject: ID0446926-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RD 170003110] OCPP Offline Issue CRM:02699000223
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas, good afternoon.
Here we are again :)
I checked remotely and router is not accessible at all:
We need to check if the router is pingable via XF2 and if it's alive (LEDs on)
If not, then we might need to replace the router.
Let me know your feedback.
BEst regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0446926-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RD 170003110] OCPP Offline Issue CRM:02699000223
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon, sir!
Could a reboot work? I won’t be on-site for the coming 3 weeks (going on holiday on Thursday).
If not, I’ll see if I can find someone else to check.
Thomas

additional_info.subject: ID0446926-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RD 170003110] OCPP Offline Issue CRM:02699000223
additional_info.body:
Hi Thomas,
This is already the 2nd time that the router is not working properly. It seems that it stops working after some time, we had a chat a few months ago where we faced the same problem.
You can reboot the charger (someone is charging right now) and when it's back I can confirm that the SIM is working. But I'm already suspecting that we need to replace it.
Please let me know when you do the reboot.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0446926-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RD 170003110] OCPP Offline Issue CRM:02699000223
additional_info.body: Okay, let’s give it a try, will keep you posted!

additional_info.subject: ID0446926-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / RD 170003110] OCPP Offline Issue CRM:02699000223

As we discussed yesterday, after the reboot, the router is back. If it reoccurs while the charger is on, please replace it.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
